# Setup Go

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Set up Go from go.mod, warm the module cache, and optionally install golangci-lint

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/setup-go@v1
```

## How it works

Go toolchain setup with module download and optional golangci-lint.

Defaults to reading the version from `go.mod`, which is the only version declaration a
Go repo should have. Module and build caches are handled by setup-go itself.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `go-version` | no | `""` | Explicit Go version. Empty reads `go-version-file`. |
| `go-version-file` | no | `go.mod` | File to read the version from. |
| `download` | no | `true` | true to run `go mod download` after setup. |
| `golangci-lint` | no | `false` | true to install golangci-lint (does not run it). |
| `golangci-lint-version` | no | `latest` | golangci-lint version. |
| `working-directory` | no | `.` | Directory to run in. |
| `cache` | no | `true` | true to enable build/module caching. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `go-version` | The Go version actually installed. |
